wantedsort-desc: Filterable and sortable list of most-linked pages that do not exist
wantedsort-summary: This page lists pages that are linked to but do not exist. Use the form to filter by namespace and change sort order. Logged-in users can export results to CSV. Full guide: [[Help:WantedSort]].
wantedsort-noresults: No wanted pages found matching your filters.
wantedsort-miser-notice: This wiki limits expensive queries. Results are capped and may not reflect the very latest links.
wantedsort-cached-notice: These results were served from cache and may not reflect the very latest links.
wantedsort-export-note: (up to $1 rows matching the current filters)
wantedsort-export-loginrequired: [[Special:UserLogin|Log in]] to export results to CSV.
